title: On Providing food for thirty men
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：provide　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 provide 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the counsellor ① provided food for thirty men without complaint, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② provides food for thirty men with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ provide food for thirty men at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ provided food for thirty men before — a line in the journal for June 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Providing food for thirty men without complaint, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ provide a fine for every late load with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Provide a fine for every late load at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ provides a fine for every late load without complaint every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ provided food for thirty men again when nobody else would.

⑩ To provide food for thirty men, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody provides food for thirty men with great care again and somebody must provide food for thirty men without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 供给（一般过去式 provided food for thirty men：1957 年谈心人头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 供给（一般现在 provides food for thirty men：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 供给（不定式 to provide food for thirty men：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 供给（过去完成时 had provided food for thirty men：1951 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 供给（动名词 providing food for thirty men 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 规定（provide a fine for every late load：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去规定规定每车迟到都要罚款）
G. v. 规定（provide a fine for every late load：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 供给（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 provides a fine for every late load，而母亲又一次 provided food for thirty men）

answers.why: provide 意为“供给”，1957 年谈心人毫无怨言地供给供给三十个人的饭食，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 provided。
provide 意为“供给”，自那以后谈心人小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 provides。
provide 意为“供给”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯供给供给三十个人的饭食”，此处为不定式 to provide food for thirty men。
provide 意为“供给”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人供给过，故用过去完成时 had provided。
provide 意为“供给”，谈心人说“供给供给三十个人的饭食这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 providing food for thirty men 作主语。
provide 意为“规定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去规定规定每车迟到都要罚款”，should ever 之后用原形 provide a fine for every late load。
provide 意为“规定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻规定规定每车迟到都要罚款（provide a fine for every late load at once），以后再也不要提起。
provide 意为“供给”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例规定规定每车迟到都要罚款，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 provides。
provide 意为“供给”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地供给供给三十个人的饭食，用一般过去式 provided 叙述。
provide 意为“供给”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要供给供给三十个人的饭食，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 provide 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the counsellor provided food for thirty men without complaint, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor provides food for thirty men with great care whenever the garden asks.
Providing food for thirty men without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever provide a fine for every late load with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.

When nobody else would, my mother provided food for thirty men again, and the garden remembered that half.
